name: notion-mcp-server
description: Connect Claude to Notion: create pages, query databases, append blocks, comment, and upload files.
long_description: Token-auth Notion MCP server. 46 operations behind 3 context-efficient tools (read, write, describe): pages, databases, views, blocks, comments, users, files, and templates — with batched mutations, automatic retry on rate limits, and full markdown round-trip. Paste a Notion Personal Access Token (create one at https://app.notion.com/developers/tokens) and everything you can see in Notion, Claude can work with.

tools.name: notion_read
tools.description: Run one Notion read operation by name: search, read pages as markdown, query databases with filters, list blocks, comments, users and views. Nothing is modified.

tools.name: notion_write
tools.description: Run one Notion write operation by name: create and edit pages and database rows, append blocks as markdown, comment and upload files. Repeated writes batch into one call.

tools.name: notion_describe
tools.description: Return one operation's JSON Schema and a working example, plus which tool runs it.

notion_token.title: Notion token
notion_token.description: Personal Access Token (ntn_...) or Internal Integration Secret. Create one at https://app.notion.com/developers/tokens — a PAT sees everything you can see, no per-page sharing needed.

notion_page_id.title: Default parent page ID (optional)
notion_page_id.description: Used by create_page / create_database when no parent is specified. Leave empty to always pass a parent explicitly.
